, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “RSL” as “reduced salinity level” (instead of “relative sea level”) and then incorrectly tied reduced salinity/density to option B. This conflated mechanism (salinity/density = option A) with the correct effect (drop in sea level = reduced ocean volume/area = option B), introducing a fundamental conceptual error that could lead to the wrong choice.
